title: STRENGTH IN
TOGETHERNESS
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp light on open vintage bible
olive branches on rustic wooden table
soft golden hour sunlight in cozy living room
two wooden chairs by a fireplace
blurred interior of a calm home kitchen

scenes.a: When you feel like you are carrying the burdens of your home entirely alone, listen.
Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labor.
For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Lord, bind our hearts together in this sacred union, protecting our family bond with Your grace.
